{{Current events|year=2026|month=06|day=22|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
***Mediators [[Pakistan]] and [[Qatar]] say that [[Iran]] and the [[United States]] have agreed to a roadmap aimed at reaching a final deal within 60 days. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy0q41v1lzo (BBC News)]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***The [[Government of India|Indian government]] confirms that four [[India]]-bound fertilizer [[cargo ship|cargo ships]] carrying [[Urea|urea]], [[diammonium phosphate]], and [[sulfur]] have successfully transited through the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/india-bound-fertilizer-ships-cross-hormuz-government-says-2026-06-22/ (Reuters)]
***Shipping data from Kpler shows that two [[Petroleum|crude]] [[Oil tanker|oil tankers]] carrying 2 ​million [[Barrel (unit)#Oil barrel|barrels of oil]] have transited through the Strait of Hormuz coming from the east, including one of the vessels showing [[Basra]], [[Iraq]], as its destination. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/oil-tanker-traffic-picks-up-through-hormuz-2026-06-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Aerial warfare in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Office of the President of Ukraine|Ukrainian deputy prime minister]] [[Oleksiy Kuleba]] says that [[Russia]]n [[Unmanned Systems Forces of Russia|drone]] attacks in [[Ukraine]] have killed at least five people, including an [[Egypt]]ian crew member aboard a [[Panama]]nian-flagged vessel in the [[Black Sea]] and three members of the same family in [[Sumy Oblast]]. The attack also damages the vessel and forces its crew to evacuate. [https://www.firstpost.com/world/five-killed-in-russian-drone-attacks-across-ukraine-amid-intensified-attacks-14025074.html (''Firstpost'')] [https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/one-dead-after-drone-hits-turkish-owned-ship-in-black-sea-223548 (''Hurriyet Daily News'')]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**The [[United Nations]] reports that the [[Tatmadaw]]'s [[Myanmar Army|army]] has killed over 700 [[Myanmar]] civilians in six months. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cnv97e42r7yo (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Iran–United States relations]], [[United States sanctions against Iran]]
***The [[United States Department of the Treasury|U.S. treasury department]] lifts [[United States government sanctions|sanctions]] against Iran and authorizes the production, delivery and sale of [[Petroleum industry in Iran|Iranian oil]] for 60 days amidst ongoing talks in [[Switzerland]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/us-lifts-oil-sanctions-on-iran-till-august-21-as-deal-talks-continue-11672356 (AFP via NDTV)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/22/treasury-iran-oil-sales.html?msockid=3450d0caccc962b81454c74acd85636e (CNBC)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/22/world/middleeast/us-sanctions-reprieve-iran-oil.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[2026 Iran war fuel crisis]]
***[[Petroleum in the United States|U.S. crude oil]] [[Price of oil|prices]] fall 2.7% to about [[United States dollar|$]]74 per [[Barrel (unit)#Oil barrel|barrel]] for the first time since early March after [[United States Secretary of the Treasury|treasury secretary]] [[Scott Bessent]] announced a 60-day waiver of sanctions on the purchase of Iranian oil. [https://www.nbcnews.com/business/energy/oil-prices-hormuz-sanctions-waiver-rcna351144 (NBC News)]
*[[Housing in the United States]]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes 85–5 to pass the [[21st Century ROAD to Housing Act]], a bill aimed at lowering the [[Cost of living|cost-of-living]] of houses and supporting [[affordable housing]] in [[United States|the country]]. The bill will be voted upon by the [[United States House of Representatives|House of Representatives]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/senate-passes-landmark-housing-affordability-bill/ (CBS News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/22/us-senate-housing-bill (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 15 people are killed, including children, and several others are injured in a fire at a commercial building in [[Lucknow]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.indiatoday.in/cities/lucknow/story/lucknow-fire-live-updates-aliganj-death-toll-rescue-operation-cm-yogi-adityanath-pm-modi-2931829-2026-06-22 (''India Today'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**The total amount of cases of [[Ebola]] in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] reaches past 1,000. [https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/5934325-ebola-outbreak-congo/amp/ (''The Hill'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–United States relations]]
**[[China–United States trade war]]
***[[China]] imposes [[Export Control Law of the People's Republic of China|export control]]s on 10 [[Economy of the United States|U.S. companies]] and bars [[government procurement]] from 46 others in response to a [[United States sanctions against China|U.S. blacklist]] targeting [[Economy of China|Chinese firms]]. The measures take effect immediately. [https://tribune.net.ph/2026/06/22/china-sanctions-10-us-firms-over-pentagon-blacklist (AFP via ''Daily Tribune'')]
*[[Australia–Canada relations]]
**[[Australia]] and [[Canada]] sign a [[A$]]2.5 billion ([[US$]]1.7 billion) agreement for the export of Australia's [[over-the-horizon radar]] system, the largest defence export deal in [[Economic history of Australia|Australian history]]. The system is intended to support long-range surveillance and monitoring in [[Northern Canada]]. [https://www.channelstv.com/2026/06/22/australia-sells-advanced-radar-to-canada-in-1-8bn-deal/ (AFP via Channels TV)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/australia-sells-advanced-radar-technology-canada-record-17-billion-deal-2026-06-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Qatar corruption scandal at the European Parliament]]
**A [[Belgium|Belgian]] [[Judiciary of Belgium|judge]] issues a [[European Arrest Warrant]] for [[Greece|Greek]] [[Hellenic Parliament|parliamentarian]] and former [[European Commission]]er [[Dimitris Avramopoulos]] for allegedly receiving payments from an organization linked to the [[Qatar corruption scandal at the European Parliament|Qatargate]] [[Corruption in the European Union|corruption]] investigation. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/belgium-issues-eu-arrest-warrant-ex-commissioner-avramopoulos-qatargate-probe-2026-06-23/ (Reuters)]
**Belgian judicial authorities request the lifting of Avramopoulos's [[parliamentary immunity]] to allow questioning regarding payments he received from an organization linked to the scandal. [https://www.thenationalherald.com/brussels-arrest-warrant-for-ex-nd-minister-dimitris-avramopoulos-rocks-athens/ (ANA-MPA and Proto via ''The National Herald'')]
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**A [[South Korea]]n [[Judiciary of South Korea|court]] sentences former [[Ministry of Justice (South Korea)|justice minister]] [[Park Sung-jae]] to 25 years in prison for being involved in former [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]]'s [[martial law]] declaration. Prosecutors state that Park assisted preparations for implementing the measure. [https://www.khmertimeskh.com/501924915/south-korean-ex-minister-gets-25-years/ (AFP via ''Khmer Times'')]
*[[2026 Côte-des-Neiges shooting]]
**A police officer, a civilian, and the suspect are killed in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Montreal]], [[Quebec]], [[Canada]]. Two other people are wounded. The perpetrator released a manifesto online, sharing [[Incel|incel ideology]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/montreal/livestory/montreal-shots-fired-offices-injured-emergency-alert-9.7244582 (CBC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/06/22/world/shooting-montreal-news (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2026 Tacloban school shooting]]
**Three people are killed and twenty others are injured, one of them critically, in a [[mass shooting]] [[School shooting|at a secondary school]] in [[Tacloban]], [[Philippines]]. Two suspects, both students, are arrested. [https://www.dzrh.com.ph/post/tacloban-school-shooting-injuries-rise-to-20-3-dead-1-critical (DZRH)] [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2250793/school-shooting-kills-3-students-in-tacloban (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-rethinks-school-safety-after-rare-shooting-kills-three-2026-06-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Corruption in Nepal]]
**[[Nepal]]ese [[Nepal Police|police]] arrest former [[Deputy Prime Minister of Nepal|deputy prime minister]] and [[Minister of Finance (Nepal)|finance minister]] [[Bishnu Prasad Paudel]] on [[money laundering]] charges. The arrest forms part of an anti-corruption campaign launched by [[Prime Minister of Nepal|prime minister]] [[Balen Shah]]'s [[Balen Shah cabinet|government]] following the collapse of [[Third Oli cabinet|the previous administration]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nepals-former-finance-minister-arrested-money-laundering-police-say-2026-06-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Koldo Case]]
**A [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Judiciary of Spain|court]] sentences former [[Ministry of Development (Spain)|transport minister]] [[José Luis Ábalos]] to 24 years in prison for taking [[bribe]]s in connection with [[public contract]]s for face masks during the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain|COVID-19 pandemic]]. His advisor Koldo García is sentenced to 19 years and businessman Víctor de Aldama to four and a half years. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/22/spanish-pm-pedro-sanchez-former-right-hand-man-jailed-24-years-corruption (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Trial of Jeffrey Donaldson]]
**A [[Judiciaries of the United Kingdom|British court]] finds former [[Democratic Unionist Party|DUP]] leader [[Jeffrey Donaldson]] guilty of all 18 charges, including one count of [[Rape in the United Kingdom|rape]], in relation to two victims who were children at the time of the offense. In a related [[trial of the facts]], the jury found that his wife, Eleanor, had [[Aiding and abetting|aided and abetted]] five offenses. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cwy2qp32d1pt (BBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/jun/22/jeffrey-donaldson-found-guilty-of-child-sexual-offences-including (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/22/world/europe/jeffrey-donaldson-child-abuse-rape-guilty-dup.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Egypt]]'s [[Central Security Forces|security forces]] detain 87 Egyptians and 136 other foreigners over illegal [[gold mining]] and smuggling along the [[Egypt–Sudan border|Sudanese border]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/illegal-gold-mining-egypt-hundreds-detained-sudan-b3000766.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Labour Party leadership crisis]]
**[[Keir Starmer]] announces his [[resignation]] as [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British prime minister]] and [[Leader of the Labour Party (UK)|leader]] of the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] in an address to [[United Kingdom|the nation]] outside [[10 Downing Street]], [[London]]. He will remain as [[Caretaker government|caretaker prime minister]] until [[2026 Labour Party leadership election (UK)|a new party leader is elected]]. [https://apnews.com/live/keir-starmer-resignation-uk-prime-minister-updates-06-22-2026 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/ckger03mrl0t (BBC News)]
*[[2026 Romanian political crisis]]
**[[Romania]]'s [[Parliament of Romania|parliament]] rejects the proposed government of [[Prime Minister of Romania|prime minister]]-designate [[Adrian Veștea]], which fails to secure the votes required for approval. [[President of Romania|President]] [[Nicușor Dan]] is expected to begin a new effort to form a government following the collapse of the nomination. [https://apnews.com/article/romania-parliament-adrian-vestea-prime-minister-cabinet-rejected-cebfbe0963e1650edad381012fbeba95 (AP)] [https://english.news.cn/20260623/266e2f7e661042baada967ae411c6038/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[2026 South Sudanese general election]]
**Authorities in [[South Sudan]] announce that the first [[Elections in South Sudan|general election in the country]] will be held on December 22, 2026, the first since [[2011 South Sudanese independence referendum|its independence in 2011]]. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/south-sudan-says-it-will-hold-first-ever-election-in-december-after-repeated-delays (PBS)] [https://thesudantimes.com/sudan/south-sudan-sets-december-22-for-long-awaited-general-elections/ (''The Sudan Times'')]
*[[Mass media in the Czech Republic]]
**Employees of the [[Czech Republic|Czech]] [[Public broadcasting|public broadcasters]] [[Czech Television]] and [[Czech Radio]] are on a 24-hour warning strike to protest against the abolition of [[Television licence|licence fees]] and tying of the public media budget to the [[government budget]]. [https://apnews.com/article/czech-public-media-financing-protest-babis-44f951daaa32331369124c10522b38c1 (AP)] [https://www.swissinfo.ch/ger/warnstreik-in-tschechien-protest-gegen-rundfunkpl%C3%A4ne/91626732 (Swissinfo)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 FIFA World Cup]]
**[[Argentina at the FIFA World Cup]]
***In [[association football]], [[Argentina national football team|Argentine]] [[Forward (association football)|forward]] and captain [[Lionel Messi]] overtakes [[Germany national football team|Germany]]'s [[Miroslav Klose]] as the [[FIFA World Cup]]'s all-time [[List of FIFA World Cup top goalscorers|top-goalscorer]] with 18 goals after scoring a [[Brace (association football)|brace]] in a 2–0 win over [[Austria national football team|Austria]] in the [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group J|group stage]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/sports/20260622-magic-messi-makes-world-cup-history-to-send-argentina-into-last-32 (AFP via RFI)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/sports/soccer/lionel-messi-breaks-record-career-goals-scored-world-cup-rcna351168 (NBC News)]
*[[2030 Winter Olympics]]
**The [[International Olympic Committee]] approves revisions to the venue plan for the 2030 [[Winter Olympics]] in the [[French Alps]], including the proposed use of [[Thialf]] in the [[Netherlands]] for [[Speed skating at the Winter Olympics|speed skating]], as [[France]] lacks a suitable venue for the event. [https://www.thestar.com/sports/olympics-and-paralympics/olympics-in-french-alps-will-go-dutch-for-speed-skating-and-move-ice-events-to-lyon-from-nice/article_f63d84e9-cd2e-5a05-a933-8d3ee971a712.html (AP via ''Toronto Star'')]
*[[2026 NCAA Division I baseball tournament]]
**In [[college baseball|college]] [[baseball]], the [[Oklahoma Sooners]] [[Oklahoma Sooners baseball|baseball team]] defeat the [[North Carolina Tar Heels baseball|North Carolina Tar Heels]], 13–2, to [[2026 Men's College World Series|win]] the [[College World Series]] for the first time since their [[1994 Oklahoma Sooners baseball team|1994 season]]. [https://apnews.com/article/cws-finals-oklahoma-north-carolina-1c1f4e468dd2f1c6608d7d2c231fc07e (AP)] [https://www.tarheeltimes.com/article167187.aspx (''Tar Heel Times'')]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
